grants.description: Verify your identity as the executor or administrator of the estate
grants.purpose: To confirm you have legal authority to act on behalf of the estate

grants.description: Provide details of the deceased person whose estate you are administering
grants.purpose: To identify the estate and calculate applicable nil-rate bands and exemptions

grants.description: Share property, bank account, and asset valuations with HMRC
grants.purpose: To calculate the gross and net value of the estate for Inheritance Tax assessment

grants.description: Declare gifts made by the deceased in the 7 years before death
grants.purpose: To assess whether taper relief applies and calculate total taxable estate including potentially exempt transfers

grants.description: Share details of the will and intended distribution of the estate
grants.purpose: To determine applicable exemptions (spouse, charity) and residence nil-rate band eligibility

grants.description: Authorize payment of Inheritance Tax from estate funds or personal funds
grants.purpose: To pay the calculated Inheritance Tax before probate can be granted

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Inheritance Tax helpline on 0300 123 1072 or through your HMRC online account
revocation.effect: Return will not be processed and probate cannot be granted. Outstanding tax liability remains. Penalties may apply if payment deadline is missed.

delegation.limitations: Agent CANNOT make payment on your behalf without explicit confirmation of amount. Agent CANNOT submit the final IHT400 return without your review and approval. Agent CANNOT handle complex cases involving trusts, business relief, agricultural relief, or foreign domicile - these require handoff to human specialist or professional advisor. Agent CANNOT provide tax planning advice or recommend ways to reduce liability. Agent CANNOT verify authenticity of asset valuations - you remain responsible for accuracy.
